limits: These are native Canvas renders of the real FightEngine, not browser screenshots. DOM, CSS, browser input and browser image decoding remain untested.

Versioned PNG bytes are verified unchanged over HTTP. Sharp then normalizes PNG encoding only in memory because @napi-rs/canvas rejects some C2PA-bearing PNG files. Full decoded pixel equality is checked before native rendering. Original files remain unchanged.
Minimal browser-global adapters supply storage/events/gamepad absence.
Normal engine intros and updates are used. Actor position, facing, pose and health are never overridden. No repo files are changed.
Opposite orientation is a runtime mirror, not additional source anatomy. Static idle candidates do not establish native animation or 1:1 fidelity.
